text: The purpose of this report is to seek Board approval of a bargaining mandate for negotiations with IATSE Local B-173, which represents housekeeping staff at the Meridian Arts Centre.

The Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approved the bargaining mandate with IATSE Local B-173, as outlined in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 27, 2026) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (February 27, 2026) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live. remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains labour relations information or employee negotiations.
